scientific_limitations: CIR is raw-IQ NAV/code/Doppler-wiped code-domain correlation using Stage0 tracking inputs; it is not reconstructed from SAGE alpha and is not calibrated independent channel truth.
PDP is the arithmetic mean of 40 one-ms CIR snapshot powers, not coherent summation.
Overlapping Stage0 windows share samples and are not independent.
Reported PDP RMS width is a signed code-delay correlation width, not a validated physical multipath RMS delay spread.
Boundary-bin PDP peaks are retained and reported without changing the frozen delay grid.
WP5 alpha linkage verifies identity only; it does not prove cross-window phase coherence, absolute gain or reflector tracking.

Legacy baseline lacks historical cohort, Stage0 and HDF5 SHA pins. Run identity and frozen SAGE SHA match the cohort/WP5 manifest; Stage2 CSV is manifest-SHA-pinned; sibling Stage0 CSV is observed and fully aligned to HDF5; HDF5 SHA is observed but not historically receipt-pinned.

audit_execution_code_provenance: The full-cohort audit runner SHA was not captured at process start. The runner SHA in execution_manifest is the corrected runner used for the targeted legacy-baseline supplement; the streamed CIR/PDP auditor, identity linker and SHA utility are bound by current source hashes.
